parsed.explanation: For n=2, Liu’s proposed marks at 1/5 and 2/5 create lengths 1/5, 1/5, 3/5. Xiang may use just one of his allowed two marks to bisect the 3/5 piece, producing lengths 3/10, 3/10, 1/5, 1/5. Under optimal alternating selection, Liu takes one 3/10 piece and one 1/5 piece, totaling 1/2, while Xiang receives the same. Thus this strategy does not guarantee the claimed 3/5. The objection is fatal to the proposed lower-bound strategy, and the write-up contains no later proof repairing it.
